# Pro Pakistan Tech
> Telecom, Enterprise IT, AI & Digital Economy Intelligence

Authoritative technology news publication covering 5G rollout, IT exports, AI startups, and fintech rails in Pakistan.

## Canonical Website
- Website: https://pro-pakistan.github.io
- Category Coverage: 5G & Telecom, Digital Economy, AI & Startups, Fintech & Banking, Hardware & Chips
- Data Format: JSON, HTML5, Structured Schema.org NewsArticle

## Curated Dossiers & Articles
- [Pakistan’s 5G Spectrum Auction: PTA Finalizes 3.5 GHz Bands for Commercial Rollout](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#pakistan-5g-spectrum-auction-dossier): With an estimated $600M spectrum valuation and fiber-to-the-tower mandates, Pakistan prepares for ultra-low latency gigabit mobile infrastructure. (Metric: 3.5 GHz PRIME SPECTRUM BAND)
- [Pakistan IT Exports Surge Past $3.8 Billion: Software Parks & Global Enterprise Contracts](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#it-exports-milestone-record-high): A depreciated rupee, booming freelance developer base, and enterprise AI outsourcing propel Pakistan into South Asia’s fastest-growing tech exporter. (Metric: $3.8B ANNUAL IT EXPORTS)
- [The Rise of Pakistani AI Labs: Deep-Tech Startups Secure Institutional Seed Capital](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#generative-ai-startup-funding-boom): From Urdu large language models to automated legal tech and medical diagnostics, domestic founders attract cross-border venture backing. (Metric: $42M Q3 VC INFLOWS)
- [Raast P2M Revolution: How Micro-Merchant QR Codes Are Demonetizing Cash in Pakistan](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#raast-instant-payments-revolution): With over 40 million registered IDs and zero interchange fees, the State Bank’s instant payment rail is digitizing mom-and-pop retail nationwide. (Metric: 40M+ REGISTERED USERS)
- [RISC-V Architecture: Pakistan’s Push to Become an Open-Source Chip Design Powerhouse](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#semiconductor-chip-design-initiative): University research labs in Islamabad tape out sub-28nm automotive and IoT silicon, bypassing costly proprietary intellectual property licenses. (Metric: 28nm FABRICATION PROCESS)
- [Electric Two-Wheelers Take Flight: Local Battery Assembly Cuts Fuel Import Bill](https://pro-pakistan.github.io/#ev-manufacturing-battery-ecosystem): With lithium iron phosphate (LFP) pack assembly lines launching in Karachi and Lahore, electric bikes reach total cost of ownership parity with petrol. (Metric: 70% RUNNING COST SAVING)
